narr: A cold front and ejecting shortwave trough resulted in widespread afternoon strong to severe thunderstorms resulting in large hail and strong winds. Additionally, flash flooding due to slow-moving and training thunderstorms.
ev: Public photo of flood waters crossing FM 670 at the intersection of CR 337 in southern Mitchell County.
